Author: Nikola Hristov
Message:
build(deps-dev): Update development dependencies and adjust workflows

This commit updates several development dependencies to their latest versions:
- @cloudflare/workers-types updated from 4.20260101.0 to 4.20260118.0
- miniflare updated from 4.20251217.0 to 4.20260114.0
- wrangler updated from 4.56.0 to 4.59.2

Additionally, the NPM publish workflow has been adjusted by removing the --provenance flag due to compatibility issues. The Rust workflow cache action has also been updated from v5.0.0 to v5.0.1 for improved performance and bug fixes. Finally, the homepage URL in package.json has been updated to point directly to the readme overview tab.
